## Architecture check

Guides: [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/ARCHITECTURE.md), [best-practices.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/best-practices.md), [nestjs-patterns.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md), [api-dtos-and-validation.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md), [security.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/security.md), [module-structure.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md), [caching-and-performance.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md), [testing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md), [commits-and-prs.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md), [reviewing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md), [remarks.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md)

1. **[Abuse controls on unauthenticated endpoints](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/security.md#L134)** — [src/modules/tokens/routes/tokens.controller.ts:103](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/d7f4a964cec1f2f38263744ee5a367413561cb84/src/modules/tokens/routes/tokens.controller.ts#L103) — Both new routes are unauthenticated address lookups and neither attaches a `RateLimitGuard` subclass, so a single call to the batch route fans out up to 20 upstream Transaction Service requests with no per-caller bound. **Fix:** add a `RateLimitGuard` subclass under `src/modules/tokens/routes/guards/` with its own `{ max, windowSeconds }` and declare `@UseGuards(TokensRateLimitGuard)` on the controller.
2. **[ValidationPipe everywhere](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md#L11)** — [src/modules/tokens/routes/tokens.controller.ts:73](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/d7f4a964cec1f2f38263744ee5a367413561cb84/src/modules/tokens/routes/tokens.controller.ts#L73) — the two new `chainId` params (line 73 and line 105) pipe bare `NumericStringSchema`, which the rule limits to pre-`ChainIdSchema` routes and states is not precedent to extend. **Fix:** on both handlers use `@Param('chainId', new ValidationPipe(ChainIdSchema)) chainId: string,` with `import { ChainIdSchema } from '@/modules/chains/domain/entities/schemas/chain-id.schema';`.
3. **[Batch and chunk upstream calls](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md#L61)** — [src/modules/tokens/routes/entities/token-addresses.dto.entity.ts:6](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/d7f4a964cec1f2f38263744ee5a367413561cb84/src/modules/tokens/routes/entities/token-addresses.dto.entity.ts#L6) — the batch bound applied before the upstream fan-out is a code-level literal, where the rule requires that size to be a named, config-driven value. **Fix:** map it in `src/config/entities/configuration.ts` and declare it in `RootConfigurationSchema` (e.g. `tokens.maxAddressesPerRequest` from `TOKENS_MAX_ADDRESSES_PER_REQUEST`), add the entry to `.env.sample.json`, and read it through `IConfigurationService.getOrThrow`.

**Verdict:** ❌ 3 finding(s)
